'''''Star Wars: The Old Republic''''' is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] book series published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] that ties in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] by [[LucasArts]] and [[BioWare]]. The first six issues of this comic are a re-release of the ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' [[Star Wars comic books|webcomics]], [[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace|''Threat of Peace'']] and [[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire|''Blood of the Empire'']], in printed format, and the third arc, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic — The Lost Suns]]'', was released only in comic format.
